scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance for Industrial Infrastructure
description:
The Scheme for Assistance for Industrial Infrastructure was launched by the Government of India in 2005. 

This scheme is part of the broader initiatives aimed at promoting industrial development in the country. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance for the development of industrial infrastructure. 

This includes the establishment of industrial parks, clusters, and estates. 

The scheme aims to enhance the competitiveness of Indian industries. 

It seeks to create a conducive environment for industries to thrive. 

The government has set a target to develop over 100 industrial clusters across the country by 2025. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme can go up to 50 percent of the project cost. 

The maximum limit for financial assistance is set at INR 10 crore per project. 

This assistance is aimed at both new and existing industrial units. 

Eligible projects must demonstrate a clear potential for job creation and economic development. 

The scheme also encourages the participation of state governments and local bodies. 

It aims to foster public-private partnerships in the development of industrial infrastructure. 

The benefits of this scheme extend to various sectors including manufacturing, services, and agro-based industries. 

The assistance can be utilized for land acquisition, development of roads, power supply, and water supply. 

It can also cover the costs of setting up common facilities such as testing labs and training centers. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme include the requirement that the applicant must be a registered entity. 

This includes private companies, public sector undertakings, and cooperatives. 

The applicant must also have a minimum net worth of INR 1 crore. 

The project must be located in a designated industrial area or cluster. 

The application process involves submitting a detailed project report. 

This report should outline the project’s objectives, scope, and expected outcomes. 

The applicant must also provide proof of land ownership or lease agreements. 

Additionally, financial statements for the last three years must be included. 

The application must be submitted to the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. 

The Ministry will review the application and may seek additional information. 

Once approved, the disbursement of funds will occur in phases based on project milestones. 

The timeline for fund disbursement typically aligns with the project implementation schedule. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade. 

Contact details for the department can be found on their official website. 

The scheme is part of the larger Make in India initiative launched in 2014. 

This initiative aims to transform India into a global manufacturing hub. 

The government has allocated substantial funds for the development of industrial infrastructure. 

In the 2021-2022 budget, INR 1,000 crore was earmarked for this scheme. 

The scheme has seen significant uptake in states like Maharashtra and Gujarat. 

These states have established numerous industrial parks under this initiative. 

The government also encourages the establishment of sector-specific clusters. 

This includes textiles, electronics, and food processing industries. 

The scheme has led to the creation of over 1 million jobs since its inception. 

It has also attracted foreign direct investment in various sectors. 

The assistance provided has been instrumental in reducing the cost of doing business. 

It has improved the overall ease of doing business in India. 

The scheme is continuously monitored and evaluated for its effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The government aims to enhance the scheme based on changing industrial needs. 

The scheme also aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals. 

It focuses on promoting sustainable industrialization and fostering innovation. 

The scheme has provisions for skill development and entrepreneurship promotion. 

It encourages the establishment of incubation centers for startups. 

The government has partnered with various industry associations for better outreach. 

These partnerships help in disseminating information about the scheme. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted to educate potential beneficiaries. 

The scheme is also linked with other government initiatives for holistic development. 

This includes the Digital India initiative which promotes technology in industries. 

The government is committed to ensuring transparency in the implementation of the scheme. 

Regular audits and assessments are conducted to ensure proper utilization of funds. 

The scheme is expected to evolve with changing economic conditions. 

The government remains focused on making India a manufacturing powerhouse. 

The Scheme for Assistance for Industrial Infrastructure is a critical component of this vision. 

It plays a vital role in shaping the industrial landscape of the country. 

The scheme not only supports infrastructure development but also boosts local economies. 

It empowers small and medium enterprises to scale up their operations. 

The government encourages innovation and technology adoption through this scheme. 

Overall the Scheme for Assistance for Industrial Infrastructure is a comprehensive initiative. 

It aims to create a robust industrial ecosystem in India. 

This will ultimately lead to sustainable economic growth and development.
